intent: The action row at the bottom of a DialogContent, staying pinned while the popup scrolls.
typical_uses: A cancel action beside the action that completes the dialog's task

dont_use_when.situation: The action row of a card on the page

invariants.text: Below 640px DialogFooter stacks its children in a column in reverse source order, so the last child sits on top; from 640px up it lays them out in a row aligned to the end, spaced var(--space-2) apart either way.
DialogFooter is sticky at the bottom of its scroll container with the popup's own opaque background, so as a direct child of DialogContent it stays in view and masks the content scrolling under it.

anti_patterns.dont: Order the footer's actions with the primary action first
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put the cancel action first and the primary action last; the row ends with the last child and the narrow column shows it on top

bad.title: The primary action first
bad.why: The row ends with Cancel, and on a narrow screen the reversed column puts Cancel above the primary action.
